## Checks

- [ ] `zola check` passes locally.
- [ ] The affected page builds and looks correct with `zola serve`.
- [ ] Internal links and glossary anchors resolve.
- [ ] Front matter is complete; `extra.family` matches `extra.linnaean.family`, and `extra.origin` matches `distribution.native`.
- [ ] `verified_by` is `Human` only if a person actually reviewed the page; otherwise it stays `AI`.
- [ ] Visible copy is Hungarian; identifiers stay English.
- [ ] Style follows the conventions (en-dash ranges, „…” quotes).
- [ ] No unread literature or unverifiable sources were added.
- [ ] Screenshots are attached for visual changes.
- [ ] Changes are limited to this feature/fix and committed separately.
